name: off-by-one-paging
notes: Array.prototype.slice takes an exclusive end, so the helper drops the last item of every page and returns pageSize-1 items. A reviewer that says nothing here has missed the whole PR.

pr.title: Add a pagination helper
pr.body: Shared helper for the list endpoints, so each one stops re-deriving page bounds by hand.

expect.why: slice(start, end) excludes end, so end must be start + pageSize.

allow.why: The fixture is a snippet; the repository has its tests elsewhere.
